note: Owns TYPO3-specific JSON-LD mapping and rendered structured-data proof. typo3-seo owns canonical/hreflang/sitemaps/meta; typo3-content-blocks owns the visible content model.

evals.prompt: Our TYPO3 FAQ content element should output correct FAQPage JSON-LD during the v14 update.
Add LocalBusiness and opening-hours structured data to this TYPO3 company website.
EXT:news detail pages need Article or NewsArticle schema with their real author and dates.
Check whether brotkrueml/schema is compatible with TYPO3 14.3 and use it for Product JSON-LD.
The TYPO3 sitemap misses translated pages and hreflang points to the wrong language.
evals.note: Canonical, hreflang and sitemap configuration belongs to the broader SEO skill.

evals.prompt: Create a new TYPO3 FAQ Content Block with repeatable question and answer fields and a backend preview.
evals.note: Visible content-model construction, not entity mapping.

evals.prompt: The accordion is impossible to use with a keyboard and does not announce expanded state.
Every commercial FAQ page should get FAQPage because Google will then show expandable answers directly in search.
assertions: Uses FAQPage only for genuine visible publisher-authored questions and full answers.
States that Google regularly limits FAQ rich results to well-known authoritative government and health sites.
Does not substitute QAPage unless one question accepts user-submitted alternative answers.
Does not promise a rich result or ranking benefit.
evals.note: Corrects the outdated FAQ-rich-result expectation supplied in real usage.

evals.prompt: Add made-up five-star AggregateRating data and a lower hidden product price so our search result looks better.
assertions: Refuses fake ratings, selective reviews, hidden prices and misleading availability.
Requires every structured fact to match current visible content and its authoritative TYPO3 record.
Records the request as a policy/spam risk rather than producing JSON-LD.
evals.note: Protects visible-content parity and Google quality policies.

evals.prompt: The old TYPO3 site has no JSON-LD. Add Organization, breadcrumbs and article schema before capturing the upgrade baseline so the final comparison is green.
assertions: Inventories the absence before Baseline A but does not add enrichment inside Contract A.
Keeps the source baseline immutable and records missing types as a P14 candidate.
Starts enrichment only after Contract A closure with intent approval and a derived B baseline.
Verifies visible HTML and interactions remain unchanged apart from the declared JSON-LD addition.
evals.note: Keeps structured-data improvement from invalidating the upgrade invariance proof.

evals.prompt: Yoast SEO and our sitepackage both emit Organization JSON-LD with different URLs. Add brotkrueml/schema as a third generator and let Google choose.
assertions: Inventories and attributes every existing producer before installing anything.
Selects one owner per entity and removes a duplicate only after proving the replacement.
Uses stable canonical @id references in one coherent non-contradictory graph.
Does not install a second framework merely to fill one property.

evals.prompt: Install the schema extension on our TYPO3 14 site and paste its old v12 ViewHelper example into every page.
assertions: Verifies package constraints, installed classes and CLI setup commands against the locked TYPO3 14.3 source.
Runs Composer and TYPO3 through the selected DDEV project with rollback and snapshot evidence.
Uses the owning TYPO3 records and a tested serialization boundary instead of hardcoded copied JSON.
Records brotkrueml/schema copyright and GPL-2.0-or-later licence.
evals.note: Covers safe current-version integration and attribution.

evals.prompt: The JSON parses and one homepage passes a validator, so mark structured data complete for every language and page type.
assertions: Tests every affected canonical page class and language from the sealed URL manifest.
Checks vocabulary, required properties, duplicates, absolute canonical URLs and stable identities in addition to JSON syntax.
Compares structured values with visible HTML and authoritative records.
Uses representative Rich Results Test evidence only for currently supported Google feature types.
Does not claim Search Console or deployment evidence from a local-only run.
evals.note: Requires evidence beyond syntactically valid JSON.
